au.footer: codes made on your device · sealed with a passphrase of their own · on every device you sign in on
au.empty: No accounts yet. Add one with the QR code a service shows when you turn on two-factor sign-in.
au.tapToCopy: Tap a code to copy it.
au.deleteText: Its codes are gone from all your devices. Turn off two-factor sign-in at the service first, or keep another way in, or you may lock yourself out.
au.qrWarning: This QR code holds the secret: whoever scans it gets the same codes. Show it only to move the account to another authenticator.
au.notAnAccount: That is neither a two-factor secret nor an otpauth:// link.
au.noQr: No QR code found in that picture.
au.foundHint: If the service asks for a code to finish setting up, enter this one.
au.pictureText: A screenshot or a photo of the QR code.
au.textLabel: Or paste the link or the secret
au.noCamera: The camera is not available here: allow it for this site, or use a picture.
au.cameraHint: Hold the QR code in front of the camera.
au.how.1: Two-factor codes (TOTP, RFC 6238) are made on your device from a secret and the time; no server is asked.
au.how.2: A backup file is your vault as it is, still sealed with its passphrase; a list of links is not sealed at all.
au.settings.importText: Import takes a backup file (with its passphrase) or a text file of otpauth:// links; accounts already here are skipped.
au.deleteFromLogin: The code is removed from this login of the password manager; the login stays. Turn off two-factor sign-in at the service first, or keep another way in.
